# Vendored libraries

Served as static files so the showcase page has no runtime CDN dependency.

| File | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard License (no charge) — https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | GSAP 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard License (no charge) — https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `lenis.min.js` | Lenis 1.3.27 | MIT — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis |

Update by running `npm pack gsap lenis` and copying the files from each package's `dist/` folder.
